description: Angular service for managing application configuration, including fetching runtime config, normalizing values, and providing accessors for config properties.

classes.name: ConfigService
classes.description: Angular service that loads and provides application configuration, with support for server-side rendering and runtime fetching.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes configuration by fetching /config.json at runtime, with fallback to defaults on failure.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes partial configuration object into a complete AppConfig with proper types.

methods.name: apiBase
methods.description: Returns the base path for API calls.

methods.name: enableSourceMaps
methods.description: Indicates if source maps are enabled.

methods.name: trustProxy
methods.description: Indicates if proxy headers are trusted.
